D021-D013_h001.question: "It’s been probably six months now, maybe a bit more, that things have just felt... off. I used to be so on top of things, especially with my clients, but lately, it's a real struggle just to get through the day. I've lost a noticeable amount of weight, too. I've cut out most things, really, just try to keep it very minimal, because I have this dreadful feeling that if I eat 'wrong,' everything will just spiral. I try to stick to very basic things. The thought of eating rich foods, anything too heavy, makes me sick to my stomach, like a panic will set in that I can’t control my own body. It’s not just the food, though. I feel this persistent sadness, a sort of heavy blanket over everything. My energy is completely zapped, and things I used to enjoy, like my book club or even just a quiet evening, just feel flat and meaningless now. Honestly, it's hard to find joy in anything."

    B. Major Depressive Disorder
    C. Anorexia Nervosa
    D. Generalized Anxiety Disorder

D021-D013_h002.question: "Honestly, doctor, I'm just so tired. It’s been going on for a few months now, this constant exhaustion. I do worry about eating anything ‘heavy’ – like, a big pasta dish or something with a lot of cheese – because I imagine it’ll just sit there and make me feel even worse, or gain it back instantly. Everything feels overwhelming at work, and even at home, I just want to be left alone. I just feel so down almost all the time, and nothing seems to lift my spirits."
